forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; Metaculus median at Feb 2028 but wide uncertainty; no new capability announcements

factors_up.factor: Musk/Amodei compressed timelines rhetoric continues
Shane Legg (DeepMind) 50% by 2028

factors_down.factor: Hassabis maintains 50% by 2030 (cautious end)
Stanford HAI: 2026 is evaluation not arrival year
Definition ambiguity depresses resolution probability

key_uncertainties: Whether current scaling paradigm hits diminishing returns
Definition of AGI for resolution purposes
update_triggers: UP: Major new capability benchmark (e.g. novel scientific discovery by AI)
DOWN: Evidence of plateau in frontier model capabilities

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; McKinsey/Accenture cuts continue but revenue still growing at top firms
forecasts.base_rate: No historical precedent for 33% industry decline in 4 years from technology

factors_up.factor: McKinsey 200 layoffs, Accenture 11K cuts in AI restructuring
Entry-level job share dropped from 41% to 26% (2018-2024)
65% of enterprises say traditional consulting losing value

factors_down.factor: Accenture Q2 FY2026 revenue $18B, raised growth outlook to 3-5%
AI creating new consulting demand (implementation, strategy)
33% threshold is very high; partial disruption more likely

key_uncertainties: Whether AI agents can replace relationship-based advisory
Speed of enterprise AI adoption vs consulting pivot
update_triggers: UP: Major firm revenue decline >10% YoY attributed to AI
DOWN: Consulting industry revenue growth continues above 3%

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: ↓ YouGov 6-7 Apr: Lab 16%, projected just 63 seats; Green surge eating into Labour base
forecasts.base_rate: Incumbent governing parties have won ~60% of UK elections since 1945

factors_up.factor: 3+ years until GE deadline; polls can shift significantly
Reform may struggle to convert poll leads to seats under FPTP

factors_down.factor: Labour at 16% in latest YouGov, projected only 63 seats
Green surge (16%) splitting progressive vote, taking 68 seats from Labour
Reform leads with 266 projected seats, 74% chance of largest party
Multi-party fragmentation uniquely disadvantages Labour under FPTP

key_uncertainties: Whether Reform can maintain coalition through to election
Impact of May 2026 local elections on party trajectories
update_triggers: UP: Labour polling recovery above 25%; Reform internal splits
DOWN: Local election wipeout for Labour in May 2026

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; Metaculus median ~2030-2031 for broad AGI definitions; long horizon provides buffer

factors_up.factor: Most expert medians now fall before 2035
Rapid capability gains in 2025-2026 suggest acceleration

factors_down.factor: Wide uncertainty bands; could be much later
Definition/resolution criteria may be stricter than expert surveys assume

key_uncertainties: Whether current AI trajectory represents genuine path to AGI
Regulatory or compute constraints slowing development
update_triggers: UP: AI system passes novel scientific discovery benchmark
DOWN: Major scaling law breakdown or compute shortage

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; China rehearsing blockades but US intel says no invasion planned for 2027; gray-zone continues
forecasts.base_rate: Post-1945 major power amphibious invasions: ~2-3 per decade globally

factors_up.factor: PRC defense budget up 7% to $278B; continued military modernization
Coast guard gray-zone blockade rehearsals increasingly realistic
Justice Mission 2025 exercises included amphibious assault rehearsal

factors_down.factor: US intel: China not committed to 2027 timeline, no fixed unification date
Gray-zone strategy suggests preference for coercion over invasion
Taiwan coast guard actively preparing counter-blockade capabilities

key_uncertainties: Whether US-China relations deteriorate sharply under current administration
Taiwan domestic political shifts affecting cross-strait dynamics
update_triggers: UP: PLA mobilization indicators; major Taiwan Strait crisis
DOWN: Cross-strait diplomatic engagement; reduced military exercises

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: → Effectively resolved NO; CPI at 3.0% in Feb, BoE forecasts 3-3.5% through Q3 2026
forecasts.base_rate: UK CPI was below 2% for 5 of 12 months in 2024; currently 3.0%

factors_up.factor: Unexpected energy price crash could provide downside surprise

factors_down.factor: CPI at 3.0% in Feb 2026, needs to drop 1pp+ in ~8 months
BoE forecasts 3-3.5% in Q2-Q3 2026; structurally above target
Higher energy prices and employer NI increases adding upward pressure

key_uncertainties: Whether services inflation decelerates faster than expected
update_triggers: UP: Sharp unexpected energy price decline; CPI drops below 2.5%
DOWN: Any CPI reading above 3.5% (already essentially resolved NO)

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; projections at $2.5B worldwide; 718M trailer views; release July 31
forecasts.base_rate: 3 of 8 MCU Spider-Man/multiverse films have crossed $1.5B; No Way Home hit $1.9B

factors_up.factor: Tracking projections at $2.54B worldwide, well above threshold
Record 718.6M trailer views in 24hrs (2x Deadpool & Wolverine)
Trailer views crossed 1B in under a week

factors_down.factor: Crowded summer 2026 slate could compress individual grosses
MCU fatigue has depressed recent non-Spider-Man entries
3.5 months from release; reviews/quality still unknown

key_uncertainties: Whether crowded summer schedule cannibalizes legs
update_triggers: UP: Strong early reviews; pre-sale records broken
DOWN: Negative test screenings; major competing release moves to same window

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: ↑ Anthropic hit $30B ARR (from $9B end-2025), passing OpenAI at $24-25B; combined ~$54-55B
forecasts.base_rate: Combined ARR ~$54-55B in April 2026; need $70B by Dec 2026

factors_up.factor: Anthropic grew from $9B to $30B in ~4 months; extraordinary acceleration
Combined ARR already $54-55B with 8 months remaining
Enterprise AI adoption accelerating across both platforms

factors_down.factor: Growth rates may moderate from current extraordinary pace
Competition from Google, Meta open-source could cap pricing
Need ~30% growth in 8 months from current combined base

key_uncertainties: Whether Anthropic's growth rate sustains or mean-reverts
update_triggers: UP: Either company reports ARR above $40B individually
DOWN: Revenue growth deceleration reported in Q2 2026

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; OBR medium-term potential at 1.5%; threshold is right at the forecast midpoint
forecasts.base_rate: UK averaged 1.4% real GDP growth 2010-2019; OBR forecasts 1.6% avg 2027-2030

factors_up.factor: OBR forecasts productivity growth rising to 1.0% by end of forecast
AI productivity gains could boost 2030s growth above trend
OBR 2027-2030 average at 1.6%, slightly above threshold

factors_down.factor: Ageing population weighing on participation and hours
Rising tax-to-GDP ratio dampening private sector dynamism
Trade policy uncertainty and post-Brexit drag
Historical UK average (1.4% in 2010s) below threshold

key_uncertainties: Magnitude of AI productivity dividend in 2030s
Whether immigration policy supports labour supply growth
update_triggers: UP: Evidence of AI-driven productivity acceleration in UK economy
DOWN: Further OBR downward revisions to potential growth
